verdict.rationale: WooCommerce ships a WC-CLI for command-line store management and a full REST API (plus JS/PHP/Python/Ruby client libraries) that could be scripted in CI pipelines, giving basic automation surface area. However there is no documented guidance for running WooCommerce headlessly in a CI environment (e.g., containerized/test-mode setup, headless deployment guide), since it fundamentally requires a full WordPress+DB stack. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless deployment documentation, containerization guidance, and independent hands-on evidence of running WooCommerce in automated pipelines.
